environment: QEMU TCG (no KVM) on an Apple-silicon Mac, UEFI OVMF with Secure Boot off, 64 GiB file-backed virtual NVMe. Not real hardware.
times: taken_at is the host clock (PDT, UTC-7); the live guest clock is UTC and the installed system reads America/New_York

frames.alt: Boot menu on a navy background with the Companion mark and six entries; Companion OS (Plasma) is highlighted.
